answer: Pre-computation is the sybil farmer's best friend, so we kill it. Each epoch's challenge is seeded by an unpredictable randomness beacon, so no one can spin up a marble-smooth batch of pre-written answers in advance. Pull one thread, the seed, and the whole spiral of required responses changes. A farm of thousands of identities must each author fresh text after the beacon lands, under a tight window, which no template mill can fake at scale.
